items.title: Collect a box of Dandy Boy Apples
items.detail: Check wooden shelves in Vault 51 Shelters Claim Center or use Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron

items.title: Complete the Event: "Mischief Night"
items.detail: Event runs hourly at Rapidan Camp; light the pyre and follow Eyebot JES-2R through mayhem acts

items.title: Kill a Lost during the "Mischief Night" Event
items.detail: Kill Lost Dwellers during Mischief Night event at Rapidan Camp

items.title: Complete the Quest: Disturbed Grave
items.detail: Quest appears after public events; find and dig up the bloodied grave in the marked search area

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Found around cabins, campgrounds, and fairgrounds; listen for child's laughter

items.title: Drink Tea
items.detail: Use Company Tea generator at C.A.M.P. or collect and drink Company Tea

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Fast travel to Blackwater Mine for reliable spawn; target head with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team!
items.detail: Join a team, enter Daily Ops, and kill Pint-Sized Phantoms; don't need to finish the operation

items.title: Kill a Rusted Deathclaw
items.detail: Fast travel to Dino Peaks Mini Golf for 3 reliable spawns; target belly with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night event at Rapidan Camp; Uninvited Phantom may spawn nearby after event ends

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at Tinker's Workbench and scrap it

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Antiseptic
items.detail: Scrap Abraxo cleaner, Industrial solvent, Turpentine, or Tick blood sacs; Ticks spawn at Big B's Rest Stop

items.title: Sell Mirelurk Queen Steak to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Hunt Mirelurk Queen at Mac's Farm or Spruce Knob Lake, cook the meat, sell to any vendor

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Fast travel does not count; sprint on open ground; Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center to Morgantown works well

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six daily challenges on three separate days during the week

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build and submit a slasher-themed C.A.M.P. or Shelter for a chance to win Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal event featuring the Pint-Sized Phantoms; runs hourly at Rapidan Camp with mayhem challenges and exclusive rewards.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Daily Operations feature double mutation spawn rates and seasonal rewards.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Scorched enemies spawn with spooky variants and bring new seasonal rewards and challenges.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Experience points are doubled, perfect for leveling up characters and maximizing progression.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this weekend event.
